# About me

I am a graduate student in Mathematics, with a concentration in Statistics, at Georgia State University. I hold an MS in Quantitative Risk Analysis and Management from Georgia State University and a BSc in Actuarial Science from Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology.

My research interests are in statistical methods for finance, particularly credit-risk model updating and tail-risk measurement. I am interested in how predictive models perform when data distributions change, and how statistical methods can be evaluated when extreme observations are sparse.

My academic and professional experience includes statistical research, teaching, and quantitative analysis.
